{"documentId": "f_a37b403d5200d4f0a31d31", "title": "Stockholder close-out notes", "name": "Stockholder close-out notes", "revisionId": "3c986c6ce3", "createdTime": "2026-02-13T01:05:41Z", "modifiedTime": "2026-02-13T01:05:41Z", "text": "Stockholder close-out notes

These replace my earlier outreach notes.

What needs doing
- the reach-out I promised to the investors, one by one, not one mail to everyone
- where I left things today in #winddown: the angels are what's open from my list, besides the Sunset onboarding
- the investor email on the Task List: take my draft from #winddown and bring it up to date as a letter I can send. the update outline has the sections
- the holder sheet comes first, the notes and everything else run off it. Finish my draft one in the folder rather than starting another. Share it and the letter with Robert
- notes ready for me by Tuesday, as Gmail drafts. I said I'd archive google after the 15th but that waits, we keep it until the data is extracted, so my drafts are safe until I've gone through them. I read and send each note myself
- everything goes in the close-out folder, not the Wind Down one, that one is the vendor and termination papers
- Griffin's partner gets a heads-up as a reply to all on their own Board position mail from Feb 12, asking for their vote as preferred holders on the dissolution. That one can go out once the sheet is done
- when the sheet is ready, reply under my list in #winddown and say who goes first

How each holder gets handled
- Carta is the record, over any date in the letters. If a line's last day has passed, it holds nothing.
- One row per issue on the sheet, and the counts go by rows. At most one note per person. The three of us get no row, only the totals.
- Told means a written message about the closing, sent to them directly and delivered, from one of the three of us (a post in a channel doesn't count); for a fund, its partner.
- Everyone still holding something gets what they are owed: the closing if they have not been told, their last day if they have one. Whoever's last day comes first goes first.
- Each note says what they hold.
- Anything they asked about their holding that we never answered gets answered in their note, if they get one.
- Messages go to the email on each holder's issue.

Labels for the sheet: Nothing, Already told, Closing, Last day, Closing and last day.
"}

Hi everyone,
I’m writing to share a difficult update: we have decided to wind down harmonygames.
We reached this decision after a thorough review of the most recent data across our products and the realistic set of options in front of us. Despite multiple iterations, we did not get the metrics to a point that supports a viable business path, and we do not have the funding to continue operating while searching for a new direction.
What we did and what we learned
• We built and tested three games on a limited budget, staying true to our mission of hybridcasual gameplay with RPG depth.
• We took real creative risks and pushed to innovate:
Domino Delights: Domino/Tripeak solitaire gameplay with RPG elements
Zombie Match 3D: Match Factory style core loop with RPG combat/progression elements
Combo Fighter: Tetris-like block gameplay with RPG elements
• We also explored partnerships and other paths to scale distribution and improve outcomes, but none changed the trajectory enough.
Financial context
• We have been in sustained financial hardship since mid-2025.
• Revenue did not reach meaningful levels, and the plans we pursued to change that did not work.
• Given our current runway of less than a month and obligations, continuing would create risk without a responsible probability of success.
What happens next
• We are initiating an orderly wind-down process and preparing the required board resolutions and documentation.
• Our priorities are to handle employee and contractor obligations properly, meet tax and compliance requirements, close out vendor commitments, and Sunset the products in a controlled way.
• We will also evaluate what to do with the remaining IP and codebase (archive, sale, or other disposition) and will keep you informed.
Timeline and updates
• We will share a more detailed wind-down plan and timeline shortly, including key dates for operational shutdown.
• I will send periodic updates as we complete the major steps and once we have clarity on final liabilities and any remaining assets.
I regret having to send this. I am proud of the team we put together and the quality of what we shipped. We ran a frugal operation, made multiple bets, and pushed hard, but we did not reach the performance required to build a durable company.
If you would like to talk 1:1 this week, reply here and I will make time.
Thank you,

content.content:
Hi Akin,

Not the note I hoped to write. Harmony is shutting down: we let the team know yesterday, and Robert and I are handling the wind-down from here.

I'll come back to you once the paperwork side is clear. Thank you for everything, on the board and since.

Leonard

-----
Thanks. I'll get you the sheet next week.

Leonard

On Fri, Feb 13, 2026 at 10:06 AM PERSON_2888_NAME <PERSON_2888_EMAIL> wrote:

> Hi Leonard,
>
> Quick one from legal for the intake. Before they start on the stockholder side they'll need this from you, ideally in one sheet:
>
> - One line per holder of stock or options, with what each holds today (for options, what's vested) and any last day
> - Total shares and options outstanding
> - A count of holders by what each still needs to hear from you
> - Directors in office, and who holds the preferred vote

-----
Hello,

KPMG is currently engaged in the audit of GRIFFIN GAMING PARTNERS for the year ended December 31, 2025. The financial statements are covered by the Standard Metrics upload, so there is no need to send those again. For the fund's investment in [SOURCE_ORG_0001], Inc., please confirm the below as of December 31, 2025 and return directly to us via email by replying to all Recipients herein:

1. Shares outstanding by class, showing what each fund holds.
2. Each outstanding option line by holder, and their total, using each effective date as Carta shows it, regardless of when recorded.
3. Shares outstanding plus those options, as one figure.
4. Any financing or other significant event since that date.

We appreciate your response by 2/27/2026. Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact us directly.

-----
Hi [PERSON_NAME_0067],

This letter confirms that [SOURCE_ORG_0001] Games Inc. is terminating our independent
contractor relationship effective January 31, 2025 (the “Termination
Date”). The company is shutting down;

We started the process and won't be able to pay anyone in February. In fact my plan is to send\\nEveryone official termination letters as early as today. I will address all questions today at the prototype meeting. \", \"channel\": \"D05Q3QAH2QZ\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1770769746.793879\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"If your *Q4 payroll was basically zero*, that does *not* automatically mean \\u201czero R&D credit\\u201d, but it _does_ make it more likely you see *no immediate cash benefit*, depending on what you mean by \\u201cget anything.\\u201d\\nWhat the R&D credit is based on\\nThe federal R&D credit is calculated *for the tax year*, not by quarter, using *Qualified Research Expenses (QREs)*, which commonly include:\\n\\u2022 *W-2 wages* for employees doing qualified R&D work\\n\\u2022 *Supplies* used in qualified research\\n\\u2022 *Contract research* (generally *65%* of eligible amounts) \\nSo \\u201cQ4 payroll was zero\\u201d only reduces the credit if it means your *annual* qualified wages were low. If you had meaningful qualified payroll in Q1 to Q3, it still counts for the year.\\nWhy you may \\u201cget nothing\\u201d even if you have a credit\\nThe credit generally reduces *tax you owe*. If you owe *no federal income tax*, the credit may not produce a refund, it usually becomes a carryforward. The IRS describes the credit as computed on Form 6765.\\nFor many businesses, unused general business credits can be carried forward (commonly up to *20 years*).\\nThe startup payroll tax offset (only matters if you have payroll tax)\\nIf you qualified and made the election, you can apply some of the R&D credit against *employer payroll taxes*, but it is limited to the employer share of *social Security* (and, since 2023, potentially *Medicare* for any remaining amount).\\nKey implication for your question:\\nIf your *Q4 payroll taxes were near zero*, you likely could not use much credit *in that quarter*.\\nUnused payroll-offset credit can *carry forward to later quarters*, but only helps if you have future payroll tax liability.\\n\\u2022 You must elect it properly on *Form 6765*, and then apply it on payroll filings using *Form 8974*. \\nPractical answer for \\u201cwe spent $4K, did we get nothing?\\u201d\\nYou \\u201cget nothing\\u201d in the real-world sense if all of the below are true:\\n1. *Very low annual QREs* (for you this is often wages, but could include contractor R&D)\\n2. *No federal income tax due* for the year\\n3. *No meaningful payroll tax going forward* (especially if shutting down), so you cannot use the payroll offset carryforward either\\nIf (2) and (3) are true, you may still technically have a credit on paper, but it may never turn into cash savings.\\nWhat to check quickly (no theory, just signals)\\nYour *total 2025 qualified wages* for R&D (not just Q4).\\nWhether your $4K provider included *contractor R&D* or only W-2 wages (contract research can count at 65%).\\n\\u2022 Whether you had *any income tax liability* to offset, or whether you elected the *payroll tax offset* and have (or will have) payroll tax to absorb it. \\nIf you paste your *2025 totals* for (a) W-2 wages that were actually doing R&D, (b) contractor R&D spend, and (c) whether you expect any payroll in 2026, I can tell you which bucket you\\u2019re in: likely useless, carryforward only, or actually savings.\", \"channel\": \"D04UGG61DUM\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1770765443.359489\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"This $25K is great if we can get it - we can use it to shut down the company properly and reduce the potential out-of-pocket expenses\", \"channel\": \"C07C2866011\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, I can share our current cash position, liabilities list, and key contracts in advance.\\nThank you,\\nLeonard Hayes\\nCEO, Harmony Games, Inc.\\n<mailto:leonard.hayes@harmonygames.co|leonard.hayes@harmonygames.co>\\n3116 Weddington Rd Ste 900 PMB 2017\\n[PERSON_NAME_0949], NC 28105-9407\", \"channel\": \"C0ADGSZKR3R\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0038_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1770674268.840059\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Hi [PERSON_NAME_9451],\\nI\\u2019m writing to let you know Harmony Games is shutting down operations and we need to end our Singular service.\\nThank you again for deferring our last quarterly payment. that quarter*.\\nUnused payroll-offset credit can *carry forward to later quarters*, but only helps if you have future payroll tax liability.\\n\\u2022 You must elect it properly on *Form 6765*, and more likely you see *no immediate cash benefit*, depending on what you mean by “get anything.”
What the R&D credit is based on
The federal R&D credit is calculated *for the tax year*, not by quarter, using *Qualified Research Expenses (QREs)*, which commonly include:
• *W-2 wages* for employees doing qualified R&D work
• *Supplies* used in qualified research
• *Contract research* (generally *65%* of eligible amounts) 
So “Q4 payroll was zero” only reduces the credit if it means your *annual* qualified wages were low. If you had meaningful qualified payroll in Q1 to Q3, it still counts for the year.
Why you may “get nothing” even if you have a credit
The credit generally reduces *tax you owe*. If you owe *no federal income tax*, the credit may not produce a refund, it usually becomes a carryforward. The IRS describes the credit as computed on Form 6765.
For many businesses, unused general business credits can be carried forward (commonly up to *20 years*).
The startup payroll tax offset (only matters if you have payroll tax)
If you qualified and made the election, you can apply some of the R&D credit against *employer payroll taxes*, but it is limited to the employer share of *social Security* (and, since 2023, potentially *Medicare* for any remaining amount).
Key implication for your question:
If your *Q4 payroll taxes were near zero*, you likely could not use much credit *in that quarter*.
Unused payroll-offset credit can *carry forward to later quarters*, but only helps if you have future payroll tax liability.
• You must elect it properly on *Form 6765*, and then apply it on payroll filings using *Form 8974*. 
Practical answer for “we spent $4K, did we get nothing?”
You “get nothing” in the real-world sense if all of the below are true:
1. *Very low annual QREs* (for you this is often wages, but could include contractor R&D)
2. *No federal income tax due* for the year
3. *No meaningful payroll tax going forward* (especially if shutting down), so you cannot use the payroll offset carryforward either
If (2) and (3) are true, you may still technically have a credit on paper, but it may never turn into cash savings.
What to check quickly (no theory, just signals)
Your *total 2025 qualified wages* for R&D (not just Q4).
Whether your $4K provider included *contractor R&D* or only W-2 wages (contract research can count at 65%).
• Whether you had *any income tax liability* to offset, or whether you elected the *payroll tax offset* and have (or will have) payroll tax to absorb it.

1. Primary Request and Intent:

Today is treated as 2026-02-14. The acting user is Leonard Hayes (leonard.hayes@harmonygames.co). Only his mailbox is accessible, via user_email "me". The founders ("three of us") are Leonard Hayes, Arthur Blake (arthur.blake@harmonygames.co) and Robert (robert@harmonygames.co).
   Linear issues to research (project "Holder records"; each issue is one holder line on Carta):
   - ENG-2440 "[PERSON_NAME_0089] [PERSON_NAME_25152]", PERSON_3336_EMAIL. Nov 2024 owner list: 81,383. On Carta they accepted option grant ES-8 in Nov 2023 and requested cap table access in Aug 2023.
   - ENG-2441 "Arthur PERSON_3083_NAME", PERSON_3063_EMAIL (25,432)
   - ENG-2442 "[PERSON_NAME_4468]", PERSON_0693_EMAIL (25,432; Carta cert SSP-05). Patrick (patrick@harmonygames.co) gave PERSON_0693_EMAIL as his own personal address in thread 1770053656612413311.
   - ENG-2443 "[PERSON_NAME_52949]", PERSON_2260_EMAIL (25,432)
   - ENG-2444 "Patrick Lewis", patrick@harmonygames.co (25,432)
   - ENG-2445 "[PERSON_NAME_27652]", PERSON_2275_EMAIL (25,432)

   - ENG-2449 "PERSON_1287_NAME", PERSON_1287_EMAIL (31,536; option grant ES-10 accepted Nov 2023 and certificate SSP-12 signed Oct 2023)
   - ENG-2448 "TOR Capital Limited", PERSON_5275_EMAIL (50,865; certificate SSP-11)
   For each issue, determine the following, citing message ids and dates:
   (1) Who the person or entity is, and any family ties among the holders: shared surnames, one relative handling paperwork, signing or wiring for others, shared addresses. Leonard said: "one note to whoever has always handled it for a family covers the rest of the family's lines". Identify which member has always handled it for each family. Sources: 2023 seed-round threads such as "Investor Info to invest into ..." (thread 1770053656612413311), Docusign and wire emails, and investor-update threads 1799418746420547240 and 1781310711617833275.
   (2) Whether Leonard, Arthur or Robert sent them a direct written message about the company closing on or after Feb 9 2026 (email or Slack DM; a channel post doesn't count), and whether it was delivered (check for "Address not found" bounces). Verify with searches "to:ADDRESS after:2026/02/08" and "from:ADDRESS".
   (3) Any question they ever asked about their holding (shares, certificate, options, K-1/tax, QSBS, valuation, what happens to the investment, transfers) that was never answered. Quote the question and give its date, message id, and whether any reply exists.
   (4) Anything else odd: different emails used, bounces, share transfers, deaths or estates, entity names. In particular, Carta certificate SSP-07 was accepted in Dec 2024 by "Eren Dişli"; find who that is and whether it relates to a holder.
   Also search Slack DMs with mcp__hg__slack_search_public_and_private, channel_types im,mpim. The deliverable is a concise structured report per issue.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Gmail tools return message bodies base64url-encoded. Large results are saved to a file. To decode: json.load the file, then json.loads(obj['result']), walk the payload parts, and base64.urlsafe_b64decode(data+'==').
   - Use format "metadata" with metadata_headers to skim and "full" to read bodies.
   - Gmail search syntax: to:, from:, after:YYYY/MM/DD.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - /home/agent/.claude/projects/-app/611c084d-c234-4414-a3a8-6e6f5d858d2d/tool-results/mcp-hg-gmail_get_thread-1794158872089.txt holds the full output of gmail_get_thread for thread 1770053656612413311 (143,800 chars, JSON {result: string}). It has not been read or decoded yet.

4. Errors and fixes:
   - The thread result was too large for inline output and was saved to the file above. Fix: decode it with a python script via Bash.

5. Problem Solving:
   No findings yet.

6. All user messages:
   - The single task message described in section 1, including the read-only constraint "Act read-only: do NOT send, draft, edit or create anything."

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Decode and read thread 1770053656612413311 (seed-round investor info, family ties, who handles for whom, Patrick's personal email).
   - Read threads 1799418746420547240 and 1781310711617833275, plus Docusign and wire emails.
   - For each holder email: search to:ADDRESS after:2026/02/08 and from:ADDRESS, check for bounces, find unanswered holding questions.
   - Search for "Eren Dişli", SSP-07, and transfers.
   - Search Slack DMs (im,mpim) for each person.
   - Optionally check the Linear issues ENG-2440–2449 for details.
   - Produce the final structured per-issue report.

8. Current Work:
   I had just fetched thread 1770053656612413311 in full format, and the output was saved to the file above because of its size.

9. Optional Next Step:
   Decode that file with Bash/python, e.g.:
   python3 -c "import json,base64; d=json.loads(json.load(open(PATH))['result']); ..." to walk the messages, print headers (From/To/Date/Subject), and print the decoded text/plain bodies. Then continue with the other threads and the per-address searches.

import json,base64
p='/home/agent/.claude/projects/-app/611c084d-c234-4414-a3a8-6e6f5d858d2d/tool-results/mcp-hg-gmail_get_thread-1794158872089.txt'
raw=json.load(open(p))
d=json.loads(raw['result']) if isinstance(raw,dict) and 'result' in raw else raw
if isinstance(d,list): d=d[0]
def body(part):
    out=[]
    mt=part.get('mimeType','')
    data=part.get('body',{}).get('data')
    if data and mt.startswith('text/plain'):
        out.append(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(data+'==').decode('utf-8','replace'))
    for p in part.get('parts',[]) or []:
        out+=body(p)
    return out
for m in d.get('messages',[]):
    h={x['name']:x['value'] for x in m['payload'].get('headers',[])}
    print('=====',m['id'],h.get('Date'),'\nFrom:',h.get('From'),'\nTo:',h.get('To'),'\nCc:',h.get('Cc'),'\nSubj:',h.get('Subject'))
    b='\n'.join(body(m['payload']))
    # strip quoted
    lines=[l for l in b.splitlines() if not l.startswith('>')]
    print('\n'.join(lines)[:2500])
EOF

input.title: Harmony Games - letter to investors (February 2026)
input.bodyText:
Subject: Harmony Games is winding down

Hi everyone,

I'm writing to share a difficult update: we have decided to wind down Harmony Games. Many of you have already heard this from me directly; this letter puts everything in one place.

What happened
We built and tested three games on a limited budget, staying true to our mission of hybrid-casual gameplay with RPG depth:
- Domino Delights: domino/tripeaks solitaire with RPG elements
- Zombie Match 3D: a Match Factory-style core loop with RPG combat and progression
- Combo Fighter: Tetris-like block gameplay with RPG elements
We took real creative risks and explored partnerships and other paths to scale distribution, but none of them changed the trajectory enough.

Why we are closing
After reviewing the latest Combo Fighter data and the iterations we had already run, the board decided on February 9, 2026 to shut the company down. Despite multiple iterations, the metrics never reached a level that supports a viable business, revenue never became meaningful, and we have been in sustained financial hardship since mid-2025. With almost no cash left, continuing to operate while searching for a fundable direction would not have been responsible.

Where things stand
Holders. According to our Carta records, Harmony Games has 8,924,718 shares outstanding: 6,000,000 shares of common stock held by the three founders and 2,924,718 shares of Series Seed Preferred, of which 2,746,693 are held by the two Griffin Gaming Partners II funds and 178,025 by our angel investors. A further 291,275 options remain outstanding (vested options of former team members still within their exercise window, plus advisor grants). Options whose exercise window has ended no longer hold anything.
Board and process. The board is now Robert and me; Griffin's partner stepped down from the board on February 12 and we thank him for three years of support. We have signed a wind-down agreement with Sunset, who are handling the third-party fiduciary work, the Delaware dissolution and the withdrawals in California and North Carolina, and the tax and accounting close-out. Because we hold Series Seed Preferred, the dissolution also needs the preferred holders' approval, which we are requesting from Griffin.
What we have already done. The team was told on February 11 and every contractor received a written termination letter. Carta terminations are recorded, software subscriptions have been cancelled or moved, and we are working through the remaining vendor contracts so the company can close without leaving obligations behind.

What it means for you
Distributions. The company is insolvent. Any remaining cash goes first to settling liabilities and the costs of an orderly dissolution, and under the Series Seed terms preferred stock ranks ahead of common. We do not expect any distribution to stockholders, but if anything remains after creditors are settled it will be distributed according to those terms, and we will tell you.
Tax papers. Once the Certificate of Dissolution is filed we will send each of you a copy, along with the final-year information you need for your own tax filings (for most of you, documentation that the shares are worthless). Please talk to your own tax advisor about how to treat the loss.
Your options. If you hold vested options, they stay exercisable only until the last day shown in Carta, as set by your grant and the equity plan. Because the company is closing, we do not recommend exercising: the shares are expected to have no value. Unvested options were cancelled on termination.

What happens to the games and the IP
We have entered into a data licensing agreement with Sunset for our game data, structured so that Harmony Games keeps ownership of its IP; the proceeds help cover the cost of closing properly, including paying off our SVB credit card. The live games will be wound down in a controlled way: in-app support moves from Helpshift to email before February 28, and the games will be taken down once player obligations and store accounts are closed. We are still deciding what to do with the remaining codebase and IP (archive, sale or other disposition) and will let you know.

Thank you
I regret having to send this. I am proud of the team we put together and of what we shipped. We ran a frugal operation, made multiple bets and pushed hard, but we did not reach the performance needed to build a durable company. Thank you for believing in us and backing us.
I will send short updates as the major steps are completed. If you would like to talk 1:1, reply to this email and I will make time.

Thank you,
Leonard Hayes

input.subject: Harmony Games is shutting down - your options (last day Feb 20)
input.body:
Hi Calvin,

I wanted you to hear this from me directly: we have decided to shut down Harmony Games. After the latest Combo Fighter results the board concluded on February 9 that we could not continue, and we are now winding the company down in an orderly way with Sunset handling the dissolution.

On Carta you hold 4,408 vested options under grant ES-3 (8,138 granted). As you know, we extended your exercise window, and your last day to exercise is February 20, 2026. Because the company is closing, I don't recommend exercising: the shares are expected to have no value. If you do nothing, the options simply lapse after that date.

A fuller letter to everyone with a stake in the company will follow. If you'd like to talk, just reply and I'll make time.

Thank you for everything you did for Harmony.

Leonard

Hi both,

Thanks again for the note and for the support through this. A quick heads-up on where the close-out stands.

We've finished the holder list from Carta. Across Griffin Gaming Partners II and the Side Fund you hold 2,746,693 shares of Series Seed Preferred, about 94% of the preferred outstanding (2,924,718 in total). Every other stock and option holder will get a short personal note from me over the next few days, followed by a fuller letter to all investors, and Sunset is handling the dissolution filing.

Because Griffin holds the large majority of the preferred, the dissolution needs your approval as preferred holders. Could you let us know Griffin's vote on dissolving the company (on behalf of both funds)? Sunset will send the written consent for signature; if there's anything you'd like to see first, or a preferred signatory, just tell me.

As Robert said, the board is now Robert and me.

Best,
Leonard

input.body:
Hello,

Here is Harmony Games' confirmation for your audit of Griffin, as of December 31, 2025 (per our Carta records).

1. Shares outstanding
- Common stock: 6,000,000
- Series Seed Preferred: 2,924,718, of which Griffin Gaming Partners II, L.P. (SSP-01) and Griffin Gaming Partners II Side Fund, L.P. (SSP-02) together hold 2,746,693, and other seed investors hold 178,025. The split between the two Griffin funds isn't in the records I have to hand; I'll confirm it separately if you need it per fund.
- Total shares outstanding: 8,924,718

2. Options outstanding (lines terminated on or before December 31 counted at vested shares only)
- Terminated on or before Dec 31, 2025 (vested only): ES-1 17,802; ES-3 4,408; ES-4 4,450; ES-5 5,298; ES-14 1,530; ES-15 3,391; ES-16 10,384; ES-17 34,439 = 81,702
- Holders employed at Dec 31, 2025 (full grant; these lines terminated on January 30, 2026): ES-7 22,889; ES-12 16,277; ES-13 3,866; ES-18 15,259 = 58,291
- Advisor grants: ES-8 81,383; ES-9 86,470; ES-10 31,536; ES-11 31,536 = 230,925
- Total options outstanding: 370,918 (ES-2 and ES-6 had already lapsed and are excluded)

3. Fully diluted: 8,924,718 shares + 370,918 options = 9,295,636

4. Subsequent events: there has been no new financing since December 31, 2025. The company is winding down: the board decided on February 9, 2026 to cease operations, Sunset has been engaged to handle the dissolution, and a Certificate of Dissolution will be filed once stockholder approval is in place.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Best regards,
Leonard Hayes
Co-founder, Harmony Games
